articles.full_text:
31-10-2026 According to the observations at 17:30 hrs MST today, the Well Marked Low Pressure Area over the Southeast Bay of Bengal and adjoining Andaman and Nicobar Islands has intensified into a Depression. It is centered at about 3.5 Nautical miles Northwest of Coco Island(Myanmar), 615 Nautical miles East-Southeast of Chennai and 650 Nautical miles Southeast of Machilipatnam, India.Weather is a few cloud to partly cloudy over the North Bay of Bengal and partly cloudy to cloudy over the Andaman Sea and elsewhere over the Bay of Bengal.
9-11-2026 Weather is a few cloud to partly cloudy over the Andaman Sea and the Northwest Bay of Bengal and partly cloudy to cloudy elsewhere over Bay of Bengal.
